item.title: Shanxi's First University-Built Satellite Returns First Orbital Data for the Taihang Constellation
item.description: North University of China's satellite, the first of 128 planned for Shanxi's Taihang Constellation, returned first telemetry and remote-sensing data a day after launch.

item.title: Nebula Constellation Plan Unveiled to Build a Domestic Space Computing Network, Chips to Satellites
item.description: The Nebula Constellation Plan targets a domestic space computing network from chips to satellites; a new Hefei company with 16 backers outlines a three-step path.

item.title: ModelBest Details LES, the Method Behind a 35B MoE Model Running on Phones at Over 20 Tokens/s
item.description: ModelBest's LES prefetches next-layer experts from phone flash; it reports 20.51 tokens/s on an iPhone, 6.07x its baseline, and has open-sourced the code.

item.title: Hygon Launches 14XX Industrial-Control CPU With 10W TDP and a -40°C to 105°C Operating Range
item.description: Hygon's 14XX is the first industrial-control CPU in its 1000 series: C86 cores, integrated GPU, 10W TDP, -40°C to 105°C operation and a 10-year supply promise.

item.title: Alibaba's Qianwen Office 2.0 Brings AI Agents Into Team Workspaces and Event-Triggered Tasks
item.description: Qianwen Office 2.0 adds shared agent workspaces linked to DingTalk chats and docs, event-triggered Automatic Tasks, in-place co-editing and a mobile app.
